newsitem.title: GERMANY: Volkswagen strong, Merrill restates as buy.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen strong, Merrill restates as buy.

text.p: Shares in German carmaker Volkswagen AG surged ahead in late afternoon electronic trade on Thursday, as dealers said positive analysts' comments had fuelled interest in the stock.
Shares in Volkswagen were up 49.95 marks, or four percent, at 1,299.05 marks at 1337 GMT, while the blue chip IBIS DAX index was down 0.36 percent.

Dealers said a reiterated "strong buy" recommendation by Merrill Lynch had buoyed interest in Volkswagen. Merrill Lynch analyst Stephen Reitman confirmed that he had reiterated his target of 1,700 marks for Volkswagen shares.
